# The eleven `dlen = 0` rows of the C oracle, plus 0x20800a2a, ASKED OF A REAL GA106.
#
# part      NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (GA106), GPU-e28d7776-e4f9-704b-d392-d46f187343f8
# host      vast.ai instance 46494693, kernel 6.8.0-59-generic
# driver    NVIDIA open kernel modules 580.159.04 (research_clones/ogkm-580.159.04, tag b81d58e)
# date      2026-08-01
# method    that source rebuilt with a chunked full-body print at rpcRmApiControl_GSP's reply
#           (ogkm-580: src/nvidia/src/kernel/vgpu/rpc.c:11065), insmod'ed in place of the
#           stock DKMS module, RmInitAdapter driven by opening /dev/nvidia0, then WIDENED
#           with `nvidia-smi -q` — which is the only thing that reaches 0x20800a4c, a
#           client-driven query rather than an init control.
#           The box was returned to its stock module afterwards and verified.
#
# Unlike rpc_transcript_real_ga106.txt, these are WHOLE BODIES, not an 8-byte head:
# every line is `+<byte offset> <up to 16 bytes>` and every block is bracketed by a
# BEGIN carrying `psize` and an END carrying it again, so a truncated capture cannot be
# read as a short reply.
#
# Repeated blocks for one cmd are repeated CALLS, kept verbatim rather than deduplicated —
# 0x20800a6c answers two different values over one boot and a dedup would have hidden it.
#
